description:
With a horrible appearance and formidable power, there's An Existence that emits out terror and fear. his name is "Nodaji" also known as "The Real man" among the men. however, he is just an ordinary high school student who wants to get along with his friends better than anyone else!  
one day a boy named "young-gi" with his pretty appearance is transferred to his school and as he watches him exploding in popularity, he bangs his knees.  
Will Daji be able to face prejudice and preconceived notions and become pretty?!
